title: CourseSphere – LMS Platform
description: Architected a full-stack e-learning platform using the MERN stack, implementing JWT Authentication and Bcrypt for secure access control. Integrated Stripe API for secure payments and Cloudinary for optimized cloud-based media management. Designed data models in MongoDB Atlas to support scalable, complex user-course relationships.

title: IMDb Clone – Media Discovery App
description: Developed a high-fidelity media discovery application using React.js, leveraging hooks and state management for a modular codebase. Engineered real-time data sync by consuming RESTful APIs, featuring dynamic search and content filtering.

title: Video-Pi – YouTube Clone
description: Developed a YouTube-inspired video platform using React.js and Material-UI with YouTube's API for seamless content presentation, data retrieval, and user interaction, enabling a familiar and intuitive video viewing experience.

title: Corporate Website Redesign
description: Revitalized a corporate digital presence using React.js and Tailwind CSS, focusing on performance optimization and SEO-friendly structure. Implemented immersive UI elements with Framer Motion and Swiper.js, reducing bounce rates through engaging animations. Collaborated on full-stack integration, connecting frontend views to Node.js services for low-latency data flow.
